text:
Ilya Protas, Aliaksei's younger brother, has made the jump to Washington at 20 and is holding his own. The 2024 third-round pick, who put up 124 points in 61 OHL games for Windsor last season, has 9 points in 21 games playing under 12 minutes a night, with four of them on the power play.

He's a passer first. Most of his points are assists (7), and he's been on for good things: Washington takes 56% of the expected goals at 5-on-5 with him on the ice, and does better with him than without. The scoreboard hasn't matched it. The Capitals have scored 5.6 fewer goals than their chances deserve while he plays, which has cost him points, and that usually swings back.

He doesn't shoot much yet (20 shots), and that will decide how far his role grows. For now, a 20-year-old in a depth job who helps his team win its minutes is a nice early sign.
